Package com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.gametest

Class RecipeGameTestsLogic

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.gametest.RecipeGameTestsLogic
public final class RecipeGameTestsLogic extends Object
The mod's two shipped crafting recipes, looked up through the server's recipe manager the way a crafting table does and driven through a headless 2×1 grid (no player/menu UI):
  • eye_modifier — one googly eye plus one recognized modifier transforms the eye's AppearanceOverride. Modifier→color mappings are asserted by presence, not exact RGB, so they don't pin a particular dye palette.
  • slimy_eye — eye plus slimeball, a vanilla crafting_transmute, which must carry the eye's appearance onto the applicator.

  • Method Details

    • cobwebClearsAllOverrides

      public static void cobwebClearsAllOverrides(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      A cobweb clears every appearance override. In game: craft a Googly Eye with red dye, then craft the result with a cobweb; the new eye's tooltip lists no colors or glow.

    • dyeSetsIrisAndKeepsUnrelatedComponent

      public static void dyeSetsIrisAndKeepsUnrelatedComponent(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Dye sets the iris color and keeps the eye's other data. In game: rename a Googly Eye in an anvil and craft it with red dye; the result keeps the name and its tooltip shows an iris color.

    • glowstoneAndRedstoneToggleGlow

      public static void glowstoneAndRedstoneToggleGlow(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Glowstone forces glow on and redstone forces it off. In game: craft a Googly Eye with glowstone dust and its tooltip shows glow on; craft one with redstone dust and it shows glow off.

    • twoEyesDoNotMatch

      public static void twoEyesDoNotMatch(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Two Googly Eyes with no modifier are not a recipe. In game: put two Googly Eyes in a crafting grid; no result appears.

    • slimyEyeCarriesTheEyesAppearance

      public static void slimyEyeCarriesTheEyesAppearance(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      A Slimy Eye keeps the Googly Eye's appearance and name. In game: rename a Googly Eye, craft it with blue dye and glowstone dust, then with a slimeball; the Slimy Eye keeps the name, its tooltip shows the same iris color and glow, and its icon's iris is blue.
